name: Inoreader
description: Feeds, subscriptions, folders, tags, unread state, saved articles, and reading workflows through Inoreader's Reader API.
agentUseSummary: Connect once through Relay-owned Inoreader OAuth, then let agents read bounded streams or use the complete selected Reader API under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

capabilities.label: Read feeds
capabilities.description: Read the connected user, subscriptions, tags, unread counts, and bounded stream contents.

capabilities.label: Full Inoreader API
capabilities.description: Subscribe, organize, tag, mark read, and use every OAuth-authorized Reader API operation.

allowed.label: List tags
allowed.description: List folders, tags, and system streams.

allowed.label: Read stream
allowed.description: Read a bounded page from a feed, folder, tag, or system stream.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Inoreader API
approvalRequired.description: Use any documented Reader API GET or POST operation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; every other Reader API operation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected OAuth-authorized Reader API operation runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, fixed origin, bounds, audits, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected tools and proxies OAuth server-side.
Railway mounts selected tools and proxies OAuth server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay must sign into Inoreader, register the production OAuth application and exact Railway callback, and configure its App ID and App Key on Railway.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create the Relay Console app, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/inoreader/callback, configure INOREADER_CLIENT_ID and INOREADER_CLIENT_SECRET, then run OAuth, health, a bounded read, and an approved or Dangerous-mode mutation.

evidence.supports: Inoreader documents confidential authorization-code OAuth, exact redirect URI matching, read or read-write scope, bearer access tokens, refresh tokens, and its auth and token endpoints.
The official developer portal documents user, subscription, tag, stream, item, preference, and mutation endpoints across Reader API rate-limit zones.
Inoreader provides an application registration path that issues an App ID and App Key; application creation requires a signed-in account.
Inoreader divides API calls into two quota zones and documents default daily request limits, so Relay bounds reads and preserves provider rate-limit errors.
